irregularities.reason: Found while refreshing: main() wrote data/sites.js BEFORE running its own integrity asserts, so the run that failed the accounting check (31 listed + 1 unlisted != 146 because /pages calls were being 403-blocked) still replaced the published snapshot with that partial 31-site file. The snapshot is now serialized first, every assert runs, and only then is the file written; a failed run leaves the previous snapshot untouched. The partial file was discarded, not committed.

The generator read GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pages twice per repository (once for the account census, once for the entry). That endpoint is the one GitHub throttles hardest: after several full refreshes in one session the endpoint began answering HTTP 403 with a secondary-rate-limit body while /rate_limit still reported 5000/5000 core calls remaining. The reads are now cached per repository (one call instead of two), 403 rate-limit responses are retried with backoff instead of being recorded as 'not a Pages site', and the run fails closed rather than publishing a short list.
